title: Realized I was in mall world mid dream
content: I just woke up from a dream I was walking around an older outside strip mall place with lots of parking lots. It was run down and kind of like a bad part of town. Lots of maids and dry cleaning type stores and crappy motels. And I was going down a hallway and said to myself “this is exactly like a mall world dream” not realizing I was in fact in a mall world dream. Haha
